dimensions.rationale: The union is drawn from all attest/compilation service types explicitly named across states; SAS-based audits and PCAOB engagements are kept separate because states consistently distinguish them; SSAE-based examinations, reviews, and agreed-upon procedures are kept as distinct items because multiple states enumerate them separately; compilation and preparation of financial statements are kept separate from attest items because states uniformly treat them as a distinct category; governmental/compliance audit is retained as a distinct item because California and Arkansas separately enumerate it.

dimensions.rationale: The union was drawn from all sentences describing conditions imposed on out-of-state CPAs (and their employing firms) exercising practice privileges across AK, AL, AR, AZ, CA, and CO; synonymous phrasings for jurisdiction, compliance, cessation, and agent-for-process were merged into single entries, while genuinely distinct cessation triggers (license lapse, criminal conviction, SEC/PCAOB bar, governmental-body suspension) and the reporting obligation were kept separate; board composition and unrelated procedural sentences were excluded as outside scope.
